scenario.name: 13-seed-departs
scenario.description: Extra (validates decision 0003 on a real network): one 40 Mbit/s seed and eight downloaders with 10 Mbit/s uplinks. The seed leaves after 20 s (about 1.5 copies uploaded); downloaders can only finish if, between them, they already hold every piece. In simulation, without the upload admission cap, no downloader finished.
